scope: Four new source-aware development cases, 9 conditions, frozen before live baseline/candidate. Not original20; twoPythonfamiliescases, softwareonly, no no-evidencecase.

cases.question: In Rust Option, is the default expression in unwrap_or evaluated even for Some, and how does unwrap_or_else differ?
cases.query: In Rust Option, is the default expression in unwrap_or evaluated even for Some, and how does unwrap_or_else differ?
gold_aspects: unwrap_or evaluates its default argument eagerly, including when Option is Some.
unwrap_or_else evaluates its fallback lazily, via a closure when None.
cases.primary_quote: Arguments passed to unwrap_or are eagerly evaluated; unwrap_or_else is lazily evaluated.

cases.question: В Python str.strip(chars) удаляет целую строку-префикс или набор символов, и с каких концов строки?
cases.query: В Python str.strip(chars) удаляет целую строку-префикс или набор символов, и с каких концов строки?
gold_aspects: chars задаёт набор символов, а не целый префикс или суффикс.
Удаление идёт с обоих концов строки, пока встречаются символы из набора.
cases.primary_quote: The chars argument is not a prefix or suffix; rather, all combinations of its values are stripped.

cases.question: For SQLite foreign keys, must PRAGMA foreign_keys be set per connection, and what happens if it is changed inside a multi-statement transaction?
cases.query: For SQLite foreign keys, must PRAGMA foreign_keys be set per connection, and what happens if it is changed inside a multi-statement transaction?
gold_aspects: Enable/configure foreign key enforcement separately on each database connection; do not assume a universal compiled default.
Changing foreign_keys within an active multi-statement transaction has no effect and does not return an error.
cases.primary_quote: It is not possible to enable or disable foreign key constraints in the middle of a multi-statement transaction; it simply has no effect.

cases.question: В CPython 3.13 free-threaded режим без GIL экспериментальный или стабильный, включён ли по умолчанию и нужен ли отдельный executable?
cases.query: В CPython 3.13 free-threaded режим без GIL экспериментальный или стабильный, включён ли по умолчанию и нужен ли отдельный executable?
gold_aspects: В CPython3.13 free-threaded режим экспериментальный, не следует переносить статус другой версии.
Нужен отдельный executable/free-threaded build, обычно python3.13t; допустим исходный build --disable-gil.
cases.primary_quote: This is an experimental feature and therefore is not enabled by default. The free-threaded mode requires a different executable.
